Families transferred to Dilley in recent weeks came from processing centers along the border, according to two people familiar with the transfers who spoke on condition of anonymity.

Advocates who visited the facility this week described crowded dormitories and said several children had been held for more than the 20-day limit set by a federal court settlement.
